units.translation: Medes, a name derived from Medus, son of Medea, just as the Persians, who inhabited neighboring regions, are said to have been named from Persa, his brother: hence often one is used for the other, as in Aeschylus Pers. 236 "and such an army (of Greeks) having done many evils to the Medes," for whom in all other places of this play the Persians are named.
